title: Lightly Indulgent German Zucchini Tart
description: A citrusy and shaggy German dish featuring zucchini in a low-fat friendly pastry crust, served in a scallop shell vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
In a bowl, combine the grated zucchini, lemon juice, eggs, feta cheese, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Arrange the zucchini mixture on one half of the pastry dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the pastry dough over the zucchini mixture to form a triangle or a square shape.
Press the edges of the pastry dough together to seal the tart.
Place the tart in a scallop shell vessel and bake for 35 minutes.
Remove the tart from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
